messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected on /v1/embeddings across us-east-1 cluster — 5xx spike, current 5xx rate 3.8% (threshold 0.5%). Alert routed to oncall.

maria (sre-oncall): I'm on it, paging the oncall rota. Can someone grab dashboards and recent deploys?

sam (platform): Looking at grafana: embeddings QPS jumped x6 in last 3m, tail latency P99 for embeddings now 2.1s (baseline 120ms). No deploys in last hour.

lee (runtime): Query patterns show many small batched embedding calls from a single route key (customer-embed-hot). KV cache misses are high. Might be causing OOMs on a few pods.

anya (support): We’ve got a handful of customer tickets saying embedding requests are timing out and retries causing duplicate load. Affected: two SMB customers and 1 enterprise.

maria (sre-oncall): Need live mitigation. Proposed: 1) surgical per-endpoint quota carve: throttle embeddings route for default tier to 30 qps, 2) temporarily disable rerank route (non-critical) to free capacity, 3) raise chat route quota for enterprise slices if needed. Thoughts?

lee (runtime): +1. We can apply per-route qps via rictl. Command:

```
rictl route update --name embeddings --qps 30 --scope default --reason "emergency-live-mitigation-4732109876"
rictl route update --name rerank --enabled false --reason "emergency-free-capacity"
```

maria (sre-oncall): Executing the embeddings qps carve now. Pushing change to control plane.

kyle (prod-ops): Noting: we'll announce to Status page once mitigation is applied. Also coordinating with billing for any enterprise carve.

maria (sre-oncall): embeddings qps reduced for default slice -> 30 qps (applied). Monitoring.

sam (platform): Seeing immediate drop in QPS to embeddings from the hot route. 5xx rate falling from 3.8% -> 0.6% in last 90s. Good.

devon (sre-backup): Rerank disable looks safe for now — done. Confirmed config pushed.

anya (support): Customers reporting fewer timeouts now. Support is triaging the two SMB tickets and telling them we throttled to stabilize.

lee (runtime): Checking pod metrics: heap/stage indicators improving, cache eviction down, p99 latencies trending down to ~250ms.

maria (sre-oncall): Good. Next: per-customer exceptions — can we allow enterprise-slice to keep previous qps? We don't want to block premium customers.

sam (platform): We can bump enterprise-slice embeddings to 120 qps temporarily:

```
rictl route update --name embeddings --qps 120 --scope enterprise-slice --reason "keep-enterprise-online-4732109876"
```

maria (sre-oncall): Applied enterprise-slice bump. Monitoring for any downstream regression.

lee (runtime): Note: this shifts load to capacity reserved for enterprise; watch for cross-tenant noisy neighbor. I will watch GPU utilization.

maria (sre-oncall): Quick customer impact summary for post-incident notes: brief 8–12m window of elevated 5xx for embeddings; primary impact on default/free tier, two SMB customers reported timeouts, enterprise slightly degraded but stayed online due to slice bump.

anya (support): Filed rapid-customer-communication: "We implemented traffic shaping to stabilize service; you may see rate limits temporarily."

kyle (prod-ops): Status page update queued: "Intermittent embedding errors in us-east-1 mitigated by rate limits and route changes. Investigation ongoing."

devon (sre-backup): Handing off to me for the 30m watch. maria, if you want to sign out?

maria (sre-oncall): Handoff ACK. devon you're now oncall for active mitigation watch. If errors drop to baseline for 15m, we roll back rerank and relax quotas gradually.

devon (sre-backup): ACK. I'll keep checking dashboards and runbook steps.

lee (runtime): Running a short test sweep to ensure no hidden cascades: synthetic traffic to embeddings and chat routes.

sam (platform): Observability: link to dashboard https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/embeds?orgId=1&from=now-30m — p95/p99 trending down after changes.

maria (sre-oncall): One more note: create a temporary quota rule to auto-scale embeddings QPS by workload class with a conservative cap, to avoid manual toggles next time. Filed as follow-up action.

anya (support): I'll follow up with the impacted customers with timeline and RCA placeholder.

kyle (prod-ops): Postmortem owner? recommend lee + maria.

maria (sre-oncall): I'll own the incident write-up with runtime metrics. Will include mitigation commands and timeline.

devon (sre-backup): Continuing watch. If anything spikes, paging again. Otherwise will update channel when we roll rerank back on. :thumbsup:

[reaction summary]: :heavy_check_mark: mitigation applied, :eyes: monitoring, :page_facing_up: postmortem assigned
